query-logpresso.query: dbquery mcs_m14 SELECT SYSDATE AS TIME, MACHINENAME, 'FOUP' AS CARRIERTYPE, FOUP_VHL_UTIL AS VHLOPERRATE, CASE WHEN FOUP_VHL_UTIL >= 80 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ALARM FROM vhlutl_vw UNION ALL SELECT SYSDATE AS TIME, MACHINENAME, 'POD' AS CARRIERTYPE, POD_VHL_UTIL AS VHLOPERRATE, CASE WHEN POD_VHL_UTIL >= 80 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS ALARM FROM vhlutl_vw | eval TIME = string(TIME,"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm"), IDC_NM = "RUNRATE" | fields TIME, MACHINENAME, CARRIERTYPE, VHLOPERRATE, ALARM, IDC_NM

table duration=1m ts_data_view_m14a | search MESSAGENAME =="RAIL-CARRIERTRANSFERREPLY" or MESSAGENAME == "RAIL-VEHICLEASSIGNED" or MESSAGENAME =="RAIL-VEHICLEACQUIRECOMPLETED" or MESSAGENAME == "RAIL-TRANSFERRING" or MESSAGENAME =="RAIL-VEHICLEDEPOSITCOMPLETED" or MESSAGENAME =="RAIL-TRANSFERCOMPLETED" | fields _time,MACHINENAME,MESSAGENAME ,COMMANDID | sort _time | eval _time = string(_time, "yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS") | eval MESSAGENAME = case(MESSAGENAME == "RAIL-CARRIERTRANSFERREPLY", "REP", MESSAGENAME == "RAIL-VEHICLEASSIGNED" , "ASSIGN" , MESSAGENAME == "RAIL-VEHICLEACQUIRECOMPLETED","ACQUIRED", MESSAGENAME == "RAIL-TRANSFERRING", "TRANSFERRING", MESSAGENAME == "RAIL-VEHICLEDEPOSITCOMPLETED" , "DESPOSITED" , MESSAGENAME == "RAIL-TRANSFERCOMPLETED", "COMPLETED","NONE") , MESSAGENUMB = case(MESSAGENAME == "REP", "1", MESSAGENAME == "ASSIGN" , "2" , MESSAGENAME == "ACQUIRED","3", MESSAGENAME == "TRANSFERRING", "4", MESSAGENAME == "DESPOSITED" , "5" , MESSAGENAME == "COMPLETED", "6","NONE") | search MESSAGENAME != "NONE" and MESSAGENUMB != "NONE" | eval TIME = string(date(substr(_time,0,12),"yyyyMMddHHmm"), "yyyyMMddHHmm"),MACHINENAME = case(MESSAGENAME == "COMPLETED", "4ACM4701", MACHINENAME) | stats count(MESSAGENAME) as MESSAGE_COUNT ,max(TIME) as TIME by MESSAGENAME,MACHINENAME,MESSAGENUMB | eval ALARM = "N", TIME = string(date(TIME,"yyyyMMddHHmm"),"yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm") | sort TIME,MESSAGENUMB ,MACHINENAME | rename MESSAGENAME as MESSAGE_TYPE | fields TIME, MACHINENAME, MESSAGE_TYPE, MESSAGE_COUNT,ALARM | eval IDC_NM = "MIN" | fields TIME, MACHINENAME, MESSAGE_TYPE, MESSAGE_COUNT, ALARM, IDC_NM

table duration=120m ts_current_job | search FAB == "M14" | eval A = case(trim(DESTMACHINENAME) == "4ABL_M10" ,1,0) | eval B = case(substr(trim(SOURCEMACHINENAME),0,7) == "4ABL330" ,1,0) | eval C = case(substr(trim(DESTMACHINENAME),0,4) == "4ALF" ,1,0) | eval D = case(substr(trim(SOURCEMACHINENAME),0,4) == "4ALF" ,1,0) | eval E = case(substr(trim(DESTMACHINENAME),0,4) == "4AFC" ,1,0) | eval F = case(substr(trim(SOURCEMACHINENAME),0,4) == "4AFC" ,1,0) | stats sum(A) ,sum(B) ,sum(C) ,sum(D),sum(E),sum(F), count by CURRTIME | rename count as TOTALCNT, sum(A) as M14AM10A ,sum(B) as M10AM14A, sum(C) as M14AM14B,sum(D) as M14BM14A,sum(E) as M14AM16,sum(F) as M16M14A | eval M14AM10ASUM = M10AM14A + M14AM10A, M14AM14BSUM = M14AM14B + M14BM14A, M14AM16SUM = M14AM16 + M16M14A, TIME = CURRTIME | sort CURRTIME | fields CURRTIME, TOTALCNT, M14AM10A, M10AM14A, M14AM10ASUM, M14AM14B, M14BM14A, M14AM14BSUM, M14AM16, M16M14A, M14AM16SUM,TIME | sort CURRTIME | sort limit=100 -TIME dst

table duration=2h oht_cmd_count | search IDC_NM == "HOUR" | sort -EVENT_DT -desc | limit 6 | fields TIME, MACHINENAME, MESSAGE_TYPE, MESSAGE_COUNT, ALARM | rename TIME as EVENT_DT, MACHINENAME as EQP_NM , MESSAGE_TYPE as IDC_NM , MESSAGE_COUNT as IDC_VAL , ALARM as ALARM_YN | eval EVENT_DT = string(date(EVENT_DT, "yyyyMMddHHmm"),"yyyyMMddHHmm"), IDC_VAL = int(IDC_VAL) | fields EVENT_DT, EQP_NM, IDC_NM, IDC_VAL, ALARM_YN | eval IDC_GRP_CD = "HOUR_MSG_CNT" | fields EVENT_DT, EQP_NM,IDC_GRP_CD, IDC_NM, IDC_VAL, ALARM_YN | sort EVENT_DT

table duration=10m test_currentjob_predict | search in(IDCCOL, "M14AM16" , "M14AM16SUM" , "M16M14A", "M14AM10A" , "M14AM10ASUM" , "M10AM14A","M14AM14B","M14BM14A","M14AM14BSUM") | stats avg(int(IDCVAL)) as IDCVAL by IDCCOL | eval IDCVAL = round(IDCVAL)

table duration=1h ts_data_view_m14a | search COMMAND == "*MHSMCS_TRANSPORT_JOB_SCHEDULE_REQ*" and TEXT == "*REQUESTOR*" | rex field=TEXT "REQUESTOR=\"(?<REQUESTOR>[^\"]+)\"" | eval REQUESTOR = case(isnum(int(REQUESTOR)), "MANUAL", case(isnum(int(substr(REQUESTOR,1,len(REQUESTOR)))),"MANUAL", REQUESTOR)) | eval REQUESTOR = case(REQUESTOR == "RTD" or REQUESTOR== "RTS", "RTD/RTS" ,REQUESTOR) | eval REQUESTOR = case(REQUESTOR == "MES" , "MHS" ,REQUESTOR) | eval REQUESTOR = case(in(REQUESTOR, SEARCHSYSTEM ),REQUESTOR, "ETC") | stats count(REQUESTOR) as REQUESTOR_CNT by REQUESTOR | search in(REQUESTOR,SEARCHSYSTEM)
table duration=1h ts_data_view_m14a | search in(LEVEL,"WARN","ERROR") | eval LEVEL = case(TEXT == "*Caused by: java.lang.*Exception*", "EXCEPTION", LEVEL) | stats count(LEVEL) as CNT by LEVEL

table duration=2h test_currentjob_predict | search IDCCOL =="TOTALCNT" | fields TIME,IDCVAL | join TIME [ table duration=2h test_currentjob_predict | search IDCCOL =="TOTALCNT" | fields TIME,LSTM | eval TIME = string(dateadd(date(TIME,"yyyyMMddHHmm"),"min",10),"yyyyMMddHHmm") ] | limit 60 | eval ABSOL_ERROR = abs(int(IDCVAL)-int(LSTM)) | prev ABSOL_ERROR | prev IDCVAL | eval IDCVAL = case(ABSOL_ERROR >= 1000,prev_IDCVAL,IDCVAL) | eval ABSOL_ERROR = case(ABSOL_ERROR >= 1000,prev_ABSOL_ERROR,ABSOL_ERROR) | fields TIME, IDCVAL,ABSOL_ERROR,LSTM | eval ABSOL_RATE = (1-(int(ABSOL_ERROR)/int(IDCVAL)))*100 | stats avg(ABSOL_ERROR) as ERROR_VALUE , avg(ABSOL_RATE) as ERROR_RATE | eval ERROR_VALUE = round(ERROR_VALUE,2),ERROR_RATE=round(ERROR_RATE,2)

table from=%s to=%s bridge_layout_test | search string(FR_FAB_ID) != "" and string(TO_FAB_ID) != "" and string(IDC_NM) != "" and string(FR_LOC_NM) != "" and string(TO_LOC_NM) != "" | eval AVG_VAL = double(AVG_VAL), CURR_VAL = int(CURR_VAL), EVENT_DT=concat(EVENT_DT,"00") ,COL1=replace(IDC_NM,"CD_", ""), COL2=replace(FR_LOC_NM, "CD_", ""), COL3=replace(TO_LOC_NM, "CD_", ""), IDC_NM=replace(concat(FR_FAB_ID,".PDT.LAYOUT.",COL1,"_",COL2,"TO",COL3,"_CURRENTQCNT")," ","") | search in(IDC_NM %s) | fields EVENT_DT,IDC_NM,CURR_VAL | pivot max(long(CURR_VAL)) as IDC_VAL by EVENT_DT for IDC_NM %s | fields EVENT_DT %s
